Permit Center Services

All permit applications are submitted online through the Community Development Hub.

Register for online access. Accounts are reviewed by city staff. It generally takes 1-2 business days to receive an email confirming approval for online access.

Electrical work must be performed by a contractor licensed with the State and registered with the City before a permit application is submitted.

Pet licences are required for all dogs over four months and must be renewed each year.

The City enforces the 2023 National Electrical Code and the 2021 International Residential Code as adopted by the State.

Apply online for solar interconnection (the utility's portal).
